text.title: One day at Deadvlei for 1,220 Namibian dollars

cafe.name: Sossusvlei Lodge, on the park gate
cafe.order: the buffet breakfast, plus a lunch pack for the dune road
cafe.when: buffet from 5am; order the pack before 6pm the night before

dish.name: oryx steak off the grill buffet
dish.tip: Book meals at check-in; the terrace serves buffet only

spot.name: Deadvlei
spot.how: 60km of tar, then 5km of soft sand
spot.when: first light, after a 1km dune walk

items: Park permit, adult per day — N$150

text.mistake: Sleep outside the park and the outer gate opens only at sunrise. The inner gate opens an hour earlier for guests inside, and that hour is the whole photograph.
